## 4. Their trajectory, and where it breaks

| Their move | Where it breaks |
|---|---|
| Class membership: 1980s down payment, Violeta's book, a Violeta-era witness | No paper; their own receipts put the down payment in 2005; their Answer calls the Violeta payments rent; the book's custody, on Gloria's own account, ends with Cesar and Salvador (the Agcaoili office knows nothing of it). |
| "Read as a whole"; Arts. 1900, 1902, 1911 | Art. 1900 protects acts within the power "as written"; the class is the written term, annotated in 1996; Art. 1374 reads stipulations together, not one out. |
| Ratification by accepting payments (Art. 1403) | Payments went to the agent's side; none reached an owner; a void sale cannot be ratified (Art. 1409[7]). |
| Revocation unregistered; publication only from 2020 | Lead with the class, not the revocation; the revocation is the alternative. |
| Prosecutor's "landowner" lines | The same resolution says it "cannot pass upon the issue of ownership." |
| Attack on our neighbours (King's perjury case and Ferrer house; de los Reyes's hearsay) | Acquittal; King does not claim the title; de los Reyes's lines withdrawn or she is not called. |
| Counterclaim: harassment through agency complaints | Those complaints stay out of 26-360 entirely; a suit that succeeds on title is not malicious. |
| Delay, appeal, stay in the house | Summary judgment or §4 ascertainment on paper; fruits run from 22 Aug 2025. |
